hero.subtitle: Describe the car you want once. Verified Swiss dealerships review your request and compete by sending you matching offers.

budget.title: What's your budget?
budget.subtitle: Dealers only send offers within your range.

vehicle.title: What are you looking for?
vehicle.subtitle: Be as specific or open as you like — broader means more offers.

specs.title: Technical preferences
specs.subtitle: Choose "Any" to receive the broadest range of offers.

features.title: Which features matter?
features.subtitle: Tap once for must-have, again for nice-to-have, once more to clear.
features.skip: You can skip this step — dealers will send offers for any configuration.

details.title: Almost there
details.subtitle: A few last details to help dealers find you the right match.
details.locationHint: Dealers near you will be prioritised.
details.notesPlaceholder: e.g. I need the car by end of March. Prefer blue or black. Open to German import.
details.whatNextBody: Your request is shared with verified Swiss dealerships. They review it and respond directly in your dashboard. No spam, no cold calls — your contact details stay private until you decide to share them.

success.title: Request sent
success.body: Verified Swiss dealerships are reviewing your request. Offers will appear in your dashboard.

footer.tagline: The smarter way to buy a car in Switzerland.
